text.en: Customers frequently praise the retail and veterinary team at Pollokshaws for their friendly, approachable, and accommodating service. Reviewers highlight named team members like Shania, Gavin, and Carlie for spending significant time answering puppy care and kitten nutrition questions. While the vast majority share warm experiences, an occasional shopper reported unhelpful interactions when purchasing aquatic pets.

title.en: Extensive product selection and parking facilities

text.en: Shoppers appreciate the spacious layout, accessible customer parking, and extensive stock of dry foods, treats, and toys at Auldhouse Retail Park. Many clients value having on-site veterinary consulting rooms alongside general pet retail under one roof. However, several reviewers noted that dog products dominate the aisles compared to cat supplies, and isolated complaints mentioned expired shelf stock.

Pet owners value being able to bring their dogs into the store while browsing shelves or attending clinical checkups. Reviewers appreciate that colleagues greet visiting animals warmly, offering friendly strokes and cuddles at the checkout counters. Clients visiting the on-site veterinary practice note that clinicians handle poorly pets calmly, helping put owners minds at ease during appointments.

q.en: Are dogs allowed inside Pets at Home Pollokshaws?

a.en: Yes, well-behaved dogs on leads are welcome inside the store and veterinary areas.

q.en: Is parking available at this location?

a.en: Yes, free customer parking is available within Auldhouse Retail Park outside the store.

q.en: Does this store have veterinary services on site?

a.en: Yes, the premises include an on-site veterinary surgery alongside the retail pet shop.
